description: Bulgaria's National Statistical Institute publishes the final 2021 census results as a set of spreadsheets, one per topic. The buildings and dwellings workbook has three tables at 7 September 2021 for the country, the statistical regions, the districts and every municipality, split by towns and villages: residential buildings by type (house, block of flats, mixed-use building, dormitory, summer kitchen, villa, building for collective households), residential buildings by whether they were inhabited, and dwellings by type, location and occupancy. The country had 2,123,121 residential buildings, 1,152,978 of them inhabited. Press releases in PDF cover residential buildings, dwellings and housing conditions, and a metadata PDF describes the method; other workbooks cover population, households, families and place of work. Format and access: free XLSX and PDF downloads, with the InfoStat database for further tables. Licence: the NSI licence lets users reuse and distribute its statistical information, including for commercial purposes, without further consent. Caveats: headings are in Bulgarian only, the tables give counts with no age, material or service variables, and the NSI site builds its menus by script. Simulation uses: municipal residential building and dwelling counts for exposure models and housing vacancy analysis. Related records: IPUMS International and the EU building stock observatory.
